mapper.insert: INSERT INTO code_masters (system_id, code_id, setting_code, text_1, text_2, text_3, num_1, num_2, num_3, display_order) VALUES (#{systemId}, #{codeId}, #{settingCode}, #{text1}, #{text2}, #{text3}, #{num1}, #{num2}, #{num3}, #{displayOrder})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM code_masters WHERE system_id = #{systemId} AND code_id = #{codeId} AND setting_code = #{settingCode}
